items.text: In adults aged 65 and over registered in primary care in high-income health systems, is higher relational continuity with a family physician, measured by any validated index, associated with fewer unplanned hospital admissions, in studies that adjust for illness severity?
items.population: Adults aged 65 and over in primary care
items.outcome: Unplanned hospital admission; admission for ambulatory care-sensitive conditions
items.time: Follow-up of at least one year

finer: Feasible for three reviewers with protected time; interesting and relevant to the reorganisation decision; novel in requiring severity adjustment and separating intervention studies; ethical as a review.
